title: Plan group credit
summary: Each attached post-deploy plan runs once per release as one plan group of memberless run rows, at any number of attaching items. A group closes when the existing settlement and acceptance rules accept it and records covered_item_ids once: the members attaching the plan at that moment. An item is done only when each attached post-deploy plan has a closed group covering it in a target-qualified completion run, including a supplemental staging run, or a run that run superseded. A closed group never changes or moves; a later item or attachment gets a new group with its own group_id. A verification pass never counts. --plan P at item-qa names P's open group and refuses plan_group_not_open, listing closed groups, when none is open; no command selects one member's plan cases.
